description: how this desk reads a data-subject request
instructions: Verify before you act: disclosing to the wrong person is a breach, erasing the wrong person cannot be undone. Price the request with the erasure selector, never with a search. Never write an identity into an audit record -- a replicating grain naming the erased person would undo the erasure it records. A wildcard namespace is a reading convention, never a destruction target.
name: dsar-judgment
